Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball.name: Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball
Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball.summary:
Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball for Game Gear adapts the console versions' gameplay and options to the capabilities of the handheld systems.

While based on the 1995 MLB season, the game does not have a MLB license, so there are no real team names used. It does however have a MLBPA license, so features real player names and their associated statistics.

J.League GG Pro-Striker '94.name: J.League GG Pro-Striker '94
J.League GG Pro-Striker '94.summary: J.League GG Pro Striker '94 is a football game released in 1994 for the Sega Game Gear. It was developed by SIMS and published by Sega. The game was part of the Pro Striker series.
